map.耐破/顶破指数计算器由耐破度与定量求耐破指数，评估纸张抗内压破裂能力，适合纸板、: The bursting (puncture) index calculator derives the bursting index from bursting strength and grammage to evaluate a paper's resistance to internal pressure rupture, suited to quality testing and grading of paperboard and packaging paper.
map.包装与纸板质控中，对比两项耐破评分/测试值，判断一致性与稳定性。: In packaging and paperboard quality control, compare two burst ratings or test values to judge consistency and stability.
map.供应商来料检验时，核对待检与标准样的两组结果差异。: For incoming supplier inspection, check the difference between the two result sets of the sample under test and the standard sample.
map.工艺改进前后，用前后两组指数评估提升幅度。: Before and after a process improvement, use the two sets of indices to assess the gain.
map.算例：两组耐破值对比（A=100，B=50）: Example: comparing two burst values (A=100, B=50)
map.：比值(A/B)=100/50=2.0000；差值=100−50=50；平均值=: : ratio (A/B) = 100/50 = 2.0000; difference = 100-50 = 50; average = 75.00. These show the relative difference between the two magnitudes. Formulas: ratio = a/b, difference = a-b, average = (a+b)/2.
map.：若两组为同批重复测试，差值 50、比值 2.00 提示离散偏大，需查设备与取样: : if the two sets are repeated tests of the same batch, a difference of 50 and a ratio of 2.00 indicate excessive dispersion, so check the equipment and sampling; if they are a sample-versus-standard comparison, quantify the deviation for traceability.

This tool compares two sets of input values; refer to actual test definitions for the physical quantities.
map.两组数值差很多是否正常？: Is a large difference between the two sets normal?
map.重复测试差值过大说明设备或取样不稳；本/标样对比则需看是否在允差内。建议结合标准: Large differences between repeated tests mean the equipment or sampling is unstable; for sample-versus-standard comparisons, check whether they fall within tolerance. Judge using the standard deviation and tolerance tables rather than single values.
